title: **R5-161 | P2 | global, arcade, garage, qfn, observatory | playability | Bench key leaks: Space jumps seated Pip, Tab toggles a hidden survey, F stands Pip up, C resets the orbit at QFN while also running CHECK**

**R5-164 | P2 | meeting | playability | Meeting: the single reel's walking reach sits on the edge of the snap radius, so 'Plug in' flickers and the spec is flaky**
**R5-166 | P2 | global | playability | There is no soft-lock or respawn spec at all: DR-15 and DR-25 are untested in every room**
